89:15.text: As for man, when his Lord tries him by giving him honour and bounties, then he says

89:16.text: But when He tries him by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"

89:17.text: Nay! But you treat not the orphans with kindness and generosity
(i.e. you neither treat them well, nor give them their exact right of inheritance)

89:18.text: And urge not one another on the feeding of Al-Miskîn

89:19.text: And you devour the inheritance all with greed.

89:20.text: And you love wealth with much love.

89:21.text: Nay! When the earth is ground to powder.
